= Contributing

This repo follows https://github.com/ZirekHQ/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md[ZirekHQ's org-wide contribution guide].

Repo-specific notes:
- Read the link:docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-11-dengjen-werger-design.md[spec]
 before picking up a story — it's the source of truth the implementation
 plan argues from.
- Every change lands through a PR; CI must be green before merge.

== Testing pyramid

Tests are split into three tiers:

|===
|Tier |Directory |Command |Covers 

|Unit |`src/test/java` |`./gradlew test` |Pure functions and I/O stubbed in-process — no real network or database. Runs on every PR. 
|Integration |`src/it/java` |`./gradlew integrationTest` |Real infrastructure this project controls — the dev Supabase Postgres via Supavisor. Runs on every PR using repo secrets; on a fork PR (no secrets available) it skips cleanly instead of failing. 
|E2E |`src/e2e/java` |`./gradlew e2e` |Live third-party services (the real Crowdin API) or the fully deployed system. Run manually with the relevant credentials — not run in CI. 
|===

A test in the integration or e2e tier that needs credentials checks for
them inside the test method with JUnit's `assumeTrue(...)`, so the test
reports as skipped ("set FOO to run against real X") when they're absent
instead of failing. Read env vars inside the test body, never in a
`static` field initializer: a missing var read eagerly there throws an
`ExceptionInInitializerError` that fails every test in the class instead
of one catchable, per-test failure.
